_about: Metadata for the Hidden Disease Finder. The maths lives in app/services/formulas.py; this file holds the human text, cut-offs and citations so every result can be explained and audited.

formulas.name: FIB-4 Index

bands.label: Low risk
bands.text: Advanced liver scarring is unlikely.

bands.label: Grey zone
bands.text: Liver scarring cannot be ruled out. Doctors usually suggest a FibroScan.

bands.label: High risk
bands.text: This pattern is linked with advanced liver scarring. Ask your doctor about a FibroScan or a liver specialist.

formulas.notes: For age 65 and over, the low-risk cut-off is 2.0 instead of 1.30 (McPherson 2017). Not validated below age 35.
formulas.next_step: Ask your doctor whether a FibroScan (liver elastography) is needed.
formulas.why_hidden: AST, ALT and platelets come from two different tests (liver test and blood count), often from different labs and dates, so nobody combines them.
formulas.citation: Sterling RK et al. Development of a simple noninvasive index to predict significant fibrosis in patients with HIV/HCV coinfection. Hepatology 2006;43:1317-1325. McPherson S et al. Am J Gastroenterol 2017;112:740-751.
formulas.simple: FIB-4 combines your age, two liver enzymes and your platelet count to estimate scarring in the liver. Fatty liver is very common in India and often silent for years.

formulas.name: APRI Score

bands.label: Low
bands.text: Significant liver scarring is unlikely.

bands.label: Watch
bands.text: Some liver scarring is possible.

bands.label: High
bands.text: This is linked with significant liver scarring. Discuss it with your doctor.

formulas.notes: Uses an AST upper limit of normal of 40 U/L.
formulas.next_step: Discuss with your doctor alongside FIB-4.
formulas.why_hidden: Needs AST from the liver test and platelets from the blood count.
formulas.citation: Wai CT et al. A simple noninvasive index can predict both significant fibrosis and cirrhosis in patients with chronic hepatitis C. Hepatology 2003;38:518-526.
formulas.simple: APRI is a second, simpler liver-scarring score that uses AST and platelets.

formulas.name: Mentzer Index

bands.label: Thalassaemia trait likely
bands.text: Small red cells with a normal-to-high red cell count point to thalassaemia trait, not iron deficiency. Iron tablets will not fix this.

bands.label: Iron deficiency likely
bands.text: Small red cells with a low red cell count point to iron deficiency. A ferritin test can confirm it.

formulas.notes: A screening index only. Confirm with Hb electrophoresis (HbA2) and ferritin. Important before pregnancy and for family screening.
formulas.next_step: Ask your doctor about Hb electrophoresis (HbA2) and serum ferritin.
formulas.why_hidden: Labs print MCV and RBC count separately; the ratio is almost never printed.
formulas.citation: Mentzer WC Jr. Differentiation of iron deficiency from thalassaemia trait. Lancet 1973;1(7808):882.
formulas.simple: When red blood cells are small, the Mentzer index helps tell apart two common causes: iron deficiency and thalassaemia trait (an inherited condition). India has an estimated 3 to 4% carriers.

formulas.name: TyG Index

bands.label: Low
bands.text: No sign of insulin resistance.

bands.label: Borderline
bands.text: Early signs of insulin resistance.

bands.label: High
bands.text: This suggests insulin resistance, which often comes years before diabetes, even when fasting sugar looks normal.

formulas.notes: Cut-offs vary between studies and populations; 8.5 and 8.8 are commonly used. Both values should come from the same fasting sample.
formulas.next_step: Ask your doctor about HbA1c and lifestyle steps to prevent diabetes.
formulas.why_hidden: Triglycerides are in the lipid profile and fasting sugar is a separate test.
formulas.citation: Simental-Mendía LE et al. The product of fasting glucose and triglycerides as surrogate for identifying insulin resistance in apparently healthy subjects. Metab Syndr Relat Disord 2008;6:299-304.
formulas.simple: TyG uses your triglycerides and fasting sugar to spot insulin resistance, when the body has to work harder to control sugar. It can show up years before diabetes.

formulas.name: TG/HDL Ratio

bands.label: Good
bands.text: Healthy balance of blood fats.

bands.label: Borderline
bands.text: Blood fat balance is drifting the wrong way.

bands.label: High
bands.text: A ratio of 3 or more is linked with insulin resistance and small, dense LDL particles.

formulas.next_step: Discuss your lipid profile and diet with your doctor.
formulas.why_hidden: The ratio is rarely printed on lipid reports.
formulas.citation: McLaughlin T et al. Use of metabolic markers to identify overweight individuals who are insulin resistant. Ann Intern Med 2003;139:802-809.

formulas.name: eGFR (CKD-EPI 2021)

bands.label: Normal or mildly reduced
bands.text: Kidney filtering is in a safe range.

bands.label: Stage G3a
bands.text: Kidney filtering is mildly to moderately reduced. If it stays below 60 for 3 months, this is chronic kidney disease.

bands.label: Stage G3b or worse
bands.text: Kidney filtering is moderately to severely reduced. Please discuss this with your doctor soon.

formulas.notes: Race-free 2021 equation. A drop of more than 5 per year is called rapid decline (KDIGO), even if creatinine still looks 'normal'.
formulas.next_step: Ask your doctor about a urine albumin/creatinine ratio (UACR) test and a kidney-safe review of your medicines.
formulas.why_hidden: Many Indian lab reports print creatinine but not eGFR, and no report shows the trend across years.
formulas.citation: Inker LA et al. New creatinine- and cystatin C-based equations to estimate GFR without race. N Engl J Med 2021;385:1737-1749. KDIGO 2012 CKD guideline.
formulas.simple: eGFR is your kidney filtering score, worked out from creatinine, age and sex. A normal-looking creatinine can still mean a falling eGFR.

formulas.name: Non-HDL Cholesterol

bands.label: Desirable
bands.text: Within the usual target.

bands.label: Above target
bands.text: Slightly above the usual target.

bands.label: High
bands.text: High non-HDL cholesterol raises heart attack and stroke risk.

formulas.notes: People with diabetes or heart disease often have lower targets (below 100).
formulas.next_step: Discuss your cholesterol targets with your doctor.
formulas.why_hidden: Not always printed; it captures all the 'bad' cholesterol particles.
formulas.citation: NCEP ATP III (2002); Lipid Association of India expert consensus (2016, updated 2020).
formulas.simple: All the cholesterol that can clog arteries, in one number.

formulas.name: Corrected Calcium

bands.label: Normal
bands.text: Calcium is normal after adjusting for albumin.

bands.label: Abnormal
bands.text: After adjusting for albumin, calcium is outside the normal range. A 'normal' calcium on the report may be misleading.

formulas.notes: Low albumin makes measured calcium look falsely low (and the reverse).
formulas.next_step: Mention it to your doctor; they may order ionised calcium.
formulas.why_hidden: Calcium and albumin are often in different panels.
formulas.citation: Payne RB et al. Interpretation of serum calcium in patients with abnormal serum proteins. Br Med J 1973;4:643-646.
formulas.simple: Adjusts your calcium for your albumin level, because low albumin can hide a calcium problem.
